data: Is there three different categories plotted under Taxonomy dataset?

The question asks whether there are three different categories plotted under the Taxonomy dataset. From the caption, we can see that the Taxonomy dataset is represented in Figure 4(b). In this figure, the categories are labeled as "Animal," "Vehicle," and "Plant." These are indeed three distinct categories. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes.
